evidence: Changes src/bitcoin-cli.cpp, which is explicitly covered under RPC / REST / ZMQ.
rationale: Fixes two regressions in bitcoin-cli that cause hangs on empty HTTP responses and premature client timeouts on slow transfers. Responses with 'Content-Length: 0 (such as authentication error responses)' previously hung waiting indefinitely for connection close, and '-rpcclienttimeout was converted into a hard phase deadline that ignores data transfer progress', causing premature aborts on active transfers (PR description).
